seedStore.topic: Why an old railway station still matters to its neighborhood
seedStore.persona: A precise, curious local historian who values ordinary detail. Reflective but never nostalgic on command or sensational.
seedStore.styleGrammar: Intimate documentary understatement. A spoken voice carries the story; music leaves space between sparse gestures and never supplies a competing hook. No trailer drums, choir, vocals, triumphal swell or sentimental crescendo.
